prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Build a finite-state machine that searches for the sequence 1101 in an input bit stream.","S02":"When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.","S03":"Reset is active high synchronous."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"reset":1,"data":1},"outputs":{"start_shifting":1},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"S0","meaning":"Reset/no-prefix state. No nonempty suffix of the input is a prefix of 1101. With reset==0 at a posedge, data=1 goes to S1 and data=0 stays S0. Synchronous reset forces S0.","update_time":"posedge","update_during_reset":true},{"name":"S1","meaning":"Longest suffix matching a prefix of 1101 is '1'. With reset==0 at a posedge, data=1 goes to S11 and data=0 goes to S0.","update_time":"posedge","update_during_reset":false},{"name":"S11","meaning":"Longest suffix matching a prefix of 1101 is '11'. With reset==0 at a posedge, data=0 goes to S110 and data=1 stays S11 because '111' has suffix '11'.","update_time":"posedge","update_during_reset":false},{"name":"S110","meaning":"Longest suffix matching a prefix of 1101 is '110'. With reset==0 at a posedge, data=1 goes to FOUND and data=0 goes to S0.","update_time":"posedge","update_during_reset":false},{"name":"FOUND","meaning":"Sequence 1101 has been detected; start_shifting is held at 1. With reset==0 at a posedge, any data stays FOUND. Synchronous reset forces S0.","update_time":"posedge","update_during_reset":false}],"rules":[{"id":"r_reset_clear","outputs":["start_shifting"],"condition":"reset == 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":0,"spec_quote":"Reset is active high synchronous.","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":1,"data":1},{"reset":0,"data":0}],"expected":[{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0}]}},{"id":"r_set_or_hold","outputs":["start_shifting"],"condition":"reset == 0 and (state == FOUND or (state == S110 and data == 1))","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.","uncertain":true,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"data":1},{"reset":0,"data":1},{"reset":0,"data":0},{"reset":0,"data":1}],"expected":[{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":1}]}},{"id":"r_default_clear","outputs":["start_shifting"],"condition":"reset == 0 and state != FOUND and not (state == S110 and data == 1)","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"searches for the sequence 1101","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"data":0},{"reset":0,"data":1},{"reset":0,"data":0}],"expected":[{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0},{"start_shifting":0}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"reset","active":"high","values":{"start_shifting":0},"first_released_cycle":"The first posedge with reset==0 after a sampled reset-high posedge; state S0 is active and normal 1101 detection may proceed from that release edge."},"mid":"Optional mid object may contain reset and/or data changes after the row's posedge sample; changed values are carried to the next row's pre-edge inputs.","uncertain":[{"rule_id":"r_set_or_hold","note":"The specification says start_shifting is set when 1101 is found but does not explicitly distinguish same-edge assertion after the final data bit from next-edge assertion; this contract selects same_cycle after the sampled posedge that completes 1101.","candidates":["start_shifting becomes 1 on the first sampled posedge that latches data=1 completing 1101","start_shifting becomes 1 on the next sampled posedge after data=1 completes 1101"]},{"rule_id":"r_reset_clear","note":"The specification only states that reset is active high synchronous and does not explicitly specify the value of start_shifting while reset is asserted; this contract assumes it clears to 0.","candidates":["start_shifting is 0 while reset is asserted and on the release edge","start_shifting retains its previous value while reset is asserted"]},{"rule_id":"r_default_clear","note":"The specification only says start_shifting is set to 1 when 1101 is found and does not explicitly specify its value before detection; this contract assumes it is 0.","candidates":["start_shifting is 0 before 1101 is detected","start_shifting is undefined or retains its previous value before 1101 is detected"]}]}
